column1: # Assumptions of use the integrator must confirm (ISO 26262-10 clause 9).
The receiving ECU evaluates the status word in every received frame and does not use the pressure value when it is flagged invalid.
The module is supplied from a regulated 12 V rail within 4.5-5.5 V at the sensor input.
The module is mounted rigidly to the master cylinder so that vibration stays within the qualified profile.
